ValidationRule.description: Story Verification Gate: blocks Ready to Promote when the latest verification found issues or failed.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Permission.Bypass_Verification_Gate), AND(copado__Promote_Change__c = TRUE, OR(ISNEW(), ISCHANGED(copado__Promote_Change__c))), OR(ISPICKVAL(Verification_Status__c, "Issues"), ISPICKVAL(Verification_Status__c, "Failed")) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Verification found issues. Fix them and run Verify again before ticking Ready to Promote. See Verification Details on this story.
